state.question: Which video includes a chilling step not present in others?
state.summary: Determine which video includes a chilling step not present in others by analyzing evidence.

events.description: Celery is being chopped on a wooden cutting board. Text overlay indicates '1/2 cup celery'.
Lemon juice and pepper are added to a bowl, then mixed with a whisk. Text overlays indicate ingredients and action.
Salad is served on a bed of lettuce in a bowl. Text overlay says 'serve on a bed of fresh lettuce'.
Chef's hand gestures near two lettuce-wrapped salads on a white tray on a stainless steel counter.
Diced green apples are shown, then lemon juice is added and tossed to prevent browning.
Cranberries and nuts are shown, then combined with apples and mayonnaise added.
All ingredients are mixed, then the bowl is shown being placed in a refrigerator.
Man appears in kitchen, speaking to camera. Background shows white cabinets, window, and appliances.
Title card appears over wooden background. Text reads 'WARREN NASH SIMPLE COOKING VIDEOS' and 'WALDORF SALAD RECIPE'.
Man cuts and removes outer leaves from a head of lettuce on a wooden cutting board.
Man adds chopped celery and lettuce to a glass bowl. A green apple is visible beside the bowl.
Final frame shows bowl with chopped lettuce, celery, grapes, and apple chunks.
Man in dark polo shirt looks down, mouth slightly open, in kitchen setting.
Close-up of a glass bowl containing chopped apples, grapes, and walnuts.
Close-up of mixed fruit salad with dressing. Text: 'Mix everything together well'.
Image of fruit salad is heavily blurred and overexposed.
Image of a refrigerator. Text: 'Allow to chill before serving'.
Image of fruit salad in a white bowl. Text: '* Good Appetite *'.

turns.summary: Determine if refrigeration in v3 qualifies as a chilling step
